description: How many days, weeks, months or business days between two dates or datetimes: calendar (Y/M/D), totals, and business days (weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays; pass country to exclude its public holidays). Use for age, tenure, countdowns, notice periods and working days until a deadline. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

inputSchema.description: business_days counts working days (default Mon–Fri, see workdays) in [from, to) minus holidays; only for date inputs.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

name: date_diff

business_days.description: Weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays (date inputs only)

title: Date difference
